# wso2is_application_share (Resource)

Shares an application with sub-organizations. Users of those organizations can then sign in to the application, and each organization gets its own copy of it. The resource manages the complete list of organizations that the application is shared with. To import, use the application ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_organization" "partner" {
  name = "Partner Inc"
}

resource "wso2is_application" "portal" {
  name = "Partner Portal"
  oidc = {
    grant_types   = ["authorization_code"]
    callback_urls = ["https://partners.example.com/callback"]
  }
}

resource "wso2is_application_share" "portal" {
  application_id   = wso2is_application.portal.id
  organization_ids = [wso2is_organization.partner.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Application ID.

### Optional

- `organization_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the organizations to share the application with.
- `share_with_all_children` (Boolean) Share with every current and future child organization. Conflicts with `organization_ids`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `application_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_application_share.portal <application_id>
```
